nom: florence by mills Clean Magic Face Wash

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this product but I do have a few complaints. First off it smells weird .. like I don't know how to describe the smell. Second it has no suds which I expected it to have. It does cleanse well though I'll give it that and the bottle is cute. I definitely prefer her Clear the Way face wash over this one!!
Def recommend! I don't have acne prone skin, so this was perfect at making my skin just feel super clean. I love how milky the cleanser feels, and it does a perfect job at also removing makeup.

This has the consistency of hair conditioner. Does not lather at all. I could maybe see this being a good morning cleanser, but I doubt this would be good for much else. I don't mind the kind of lemongrass scent this has and it definitely doesn't make your skin feel dry or tight, so those are my 2 pros. Much prefer the foaming one.
Product doesn't work, doesn't foam up. Doesn't feel like it cleanses face. Not worth the price or hype. I returned item - Ulta's no hassle returns are a great perk.

…if you're not big on texture. Rubbing this in feels like just putting water on my face. I feel like I have to use a lot for it to feel like it's doing something. This has a very thin/milky texture even though it looks thicker when I put it in my hand. The scent is cucumber melon which I wasn't expecting. It's not bad just not my preference. I haven't had any skin reactions thankfully and my face does feel clean after use, just not a fan of the feel of the actual product.
Appy cleanser, don't use water first. Thej use makeup eraser wet towel to rinse the residue. My skin is probe to acne and breakouts. It calms my skin. Absolutely amazing product!

now this florence by mills pruduct has great packaging, but the oder is good AT ALL. Then after 2 day of getting it i started using it for about 3/4 weeks and my face started breaking put in bumps ALL OVER my face. but after 2 days it settled down. ⚠️ do not recommend for dry skin⚠️

I love this cleanser. I don't wear makeup, so I can't speak to that, but it is so gentle on my combination skin. I'm not oily after I use it and not stripped either. It's great. It has a very light scent, and all the fragrant ingredients are listed if you have sensitive skin.
